# QR encoder

`qrcode.js`: unmodified qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz

SHA-256 (source archive): `ab6ed47d378877441deae95972e07b2716c26545a735a23aa6b9d442b33026ed`
SHA-256 (qrcode.js): `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`

The console uses only addData (Byte), make, getModuleCount and isDark; it draws the matrix on a canvas, not the library's HTML/image helpers. Input is the server's ASCII percent-encoded otpauth URI. No network or storage is used by the encoder. MIT license retained below.
